44: @Slf4j

52:   @Override
53:   public MutationCoordsVisitor<DataFetcher<?>, Context> createSinkFetcherVisitor() {
54:     return new MutationCoordsVisitor<>() {
55:       @Override
56:       public DataFetcher<?> visit(KafkaMutationCoords coords, Context context) {
57:         KafkaProducer<String, String> producer = KafkaProducer.create(vertx, getSinkConfig());
58:         SinkProducer emitter = new KafkaSinkProducer<>(coords.getTopic(), producer);
59:         final List<String> uuidColumns = coords.getComputedColumns().entrySet().stream()
60:             .filter(e -> e.getValue() == MutationComputedColumnType.UUID).map(Map.Entry::getKey).collect(Collectors.toList());
61:         final List<String> timestampColumns = coords.getComputedColumns().entrySet().stream()
62:             .filter(e -> e.getValue() == MutationComputedColumnType.TIMESTAMP).map(Map.Entry::getKey).collect(Collectors.toList());
63: 
64:         Preconditions.checkNotNull(emitter, "Could not find sink for field: %s", coords.getFieldName());
65:         return VertxDataFetcher.create((env, fut) -> {
66: 
67:           var entry = getEntry(env, uuidColumns);
68: 
69:           emitter.send(entry)
70:               .onSuccess(sinkResult->{
71:                 //Add timestamp from sink to result
72:                 var dateTime = ZonedDateTime.ofInstant(sinkResult.getSourceTime(), ZoneOffset.UTC);
73:                 timestampColumns.forEach(colName -> entry.put(colName, dateTime.toOffsetDateTime()));
74: 
75:                 fut.complete(entry);
76:               })
77:               .onFailure((m)->
78:                   fut.fail(m)
79:               );
80:         });
81:       }
82: 
83:       @Override
84:       public DataFetcher<?> visit(PostgresLogMutationCoords coords, Context context) {
85:         return VertxDataFetcher.create((env, fut) -> {
86:           var entry = getEntry(env, List.of());
87:           entry.put("event_time", Timestamp.from(Instant.now())); // TODO: better to do it in the db
88: 
89:           var paramObj = new Object[coords.getParameters().size()];
90:           for (var i = 0; i < coords.getParameters().size(); i++) {
91:             var param = coords.getParameters().get(i);
92:             var o = entry.get(param);
93:             if (o instanceof UUID iD) {
94:               o = iD.toString();
95:             } else if (o instanceof Timestamp timestamp) {
96:               o = timestamp.toLocalDateTime().atOffset(ZoneOffset.UTC);
97:             }
98:             paramObj[i] = o;
99:           }
100: 
101:           var insertStatement = coords.getInsertStatement();
102: 
103:           var preparedQuery = ((VertxJdbcClient) context.getClient())
104:               .getClients().get("postgres")
105:               .preparedQuery(insertStatement);
106:           preparedQuery.execute(Tuple.from(paramObj))
107:               .onComplete(e -> fut.complete(entry))
108:               .onFailure(e -> log.error("An error happened while executing the query: " + insertStatement, e));
109:         });
110:       }
111:     };
112:   }

114:   private Map getEntry(DataFetchingEnvironment env, List<String> uuidColumns) {
115:     //Rules:
116:     //- Only one argument is allowed, it doesn't matter the name
117:     //- input argument cannot be null.
118:     var args = env.getArguments();
119: 
120:     var entry = (Map)args.entrySet().stream()
121:         .findFirst().map(Entry::getValue).get();
122: 
123:     if (!uuidColumns.isEmpty()) {
124:       //Add UUID for event for the computed uuid columns
125:       var uuid = UUID.randomUUID();
126:       uuidColumns.forEach(colName -> entry.put(colName, uuid));
127:     }
128:     return entry;
129:   }

134:     conf.put(BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS_CONFIG, config.getEnvironmentVariable("PROPERTIES_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS"));
135:     conf.put(GROUP_ID_CONFIG, UUID.randomUUID().toString());
136:     conf.put(KEY_SERIALIZER_CLASS_CONFIG, "com.datasqrl.graphql.kafka.JsonSerializer");
137:     conf.put(VALUE_SERIALIZER_CLASS_CONFIG, "com.datasqrl.graphql.kafka.JsonSerializer");
138:

27: /**
28:  * It is the ExecutionContext per servlet type. It is responsible for executing the resolved SQL
29:  * queries (paginated or not) in Vert.x and mapping the database resultSet to json for using in
30:  * GraphQL responses. It also implements the parameters and arguments visitors for the {@link
31:  * com.datasqrl.graphql.server.RootGraphqlModel} visitors
32:  */
33: @Value
34: public class VertxQueryExecutionContext extends AbstractQueryExecutionContext {
35:   VertxContext context;
36:   DataFetchingEnvironment environment;
37:   Set<Argument> arguments;
38:   Promise<Object> future; // basically Vert.x completableFuture
39: 
40:   @Override
41:   public CompletableFuture runQuery(ResolvedSqlQuery resolvedQuery,
42:       boolean isList) {
43:     var preparedQueryContainer = (PreparedSqrlQueryImpl) resolvedQuery.getPreparedQueryContainer();
44:     final var paramObj = getParamArguments(resolvedQuery.getQuery().getParameters());
45:     var query = resolvedQuery.getQuery();
46:     var unpreparedSqlQuery = query.getSql();
47:     switch (query.getPagination()) {
48:       case NONE: break;
49:       case LIMIT_AND_OFFSET:
50:         Optional<Integer> limit = Optional.ofNullable(getEnvironment().getArgument(LIMIT));
51:         Optional<Integer> offset = Optional.ofNullable(getEnvironment().getArgument(OFFSET));
52: 
53:         //special case where database doesn't support binding for limit/offset => need to execute dynamically
54:         if (!query.getDatabase().supportsLimitOffsetBinding) {
55:           assert preparedQueryContainer == null;
56:           unpreparedSqlQuery = AbstractQueryExecutionContext.addLimitOffsetToQuery(unpreparedSqlQuery,
57:               limit.map(Object::toString).orElse("ALL"), String.valueOf(offset.orElse(0)));
58:         } else {
59:           paramObj.add(limit.orElse(Integer.MAX_VALUE));
60:           paramObj.add(offset.orElse(0));
61:         }
62:         break;
63:       default: throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Unsupported pagination: " + query.getPagination());
64:     }
65: 
66:     // execute the preparedQuery with the arguments extracted above
67:     Future<RowSet<Row>> future;
68:     var parameters = Tuple.from(paramObj);
69:     if (preparedQueryContainer == null) {
70:       future = this.context.getSqlClient().execute(resolvedQuery.getQuery().getDatabase(),
71:           unpreparedSqlQuery, parameters);
72:     } else {
73:       var preparedQuery = preparedQueryContainer
74:           .getPreparedQuery();
75:       future = this.context.getSqlClient().execute(resolvedQuery.getQuery().getDatabase(),
76:           preparedQuery, parameters);
77:     }
78:     // map the resultSet to json for GraphQL response
79:     future
80:         .map(r -> resultMapper(r, isList))
81:         .onSuccess(result -> this.future.complete(result))
82:         .onFailure(f -> {
83:           f.printStackTrace();
84:           this.future.fail(f);
85:         });
86:     return new CompletableFuture();
87:   }
88: 
89:   private Object resultMapper(RowSet<Row> r, boolean isList) {
90:     List<JsonObject> o = StreamSupport.stream(r.spliterator(), false)
91:         .map(Row::toJson)
92:         .collect(Collectors.toList());
93:     return unboxList(o, isList);
94:   }

20: /**
21:  * Listens for PostgreSQL notifications on a PostgreSQL channel, converts the
22:  * notification payload into a JsonObject and extracts the required parameters. These parameters are
23:  * then used to execute a predefined SQL query (onNotifyQuery)
24:  */
25: @Slf4j
26: @AllArgsConstructor
27: public class PostgresListenNotifyConsumer {

29:   private VertxJdbcClient sqlClient;
30:   private String listenQuery;

37:   public void subscribe(Consumer<Object> listener) {
38:     // Establish a direct PgConnection
39:     PgConnection.connect(vertx, pgConnectOptions, res -> {
40:       if (res.succeeded()) {
41:         PgConnection pgConnection = res.result();
42: 
43:         // Set the notification handler
44:         pgConnection.notificationHandler(notification -> {
45:           log.trace("Received notification on channel: {} Payload: {}",
46:               notification.getChannel(), notification.getPayload());
47: 
48:           handleNotification(notification, listener);
49:         });
50: 
51:         // Execute the LISTEN command to listen for notifications on a specific channel
52:         pgConnection.query(listenQuery).execute(queryResult -> {
53:           if (queryResult.succeeded()) {
54:             log.info("LISTEN command executed successfully: {}", listenQuery);
55:           } else {
56:             log.error("Unable to execute LISTEN command: %s".formatted(queryResult.cause().getMessage()), queryResult.cause());
57:           }
58:         });
59:       } else {
60:         log.error("Unable to establish connection. %s".formatted(res.cause().getMessage()), res.cause());
61:       }
62:     });
63:   }

66:     var jsonPayload = new JsonObject(notification.getPayload());
67: 
68:     List<Object> paramObj = new ArrayList<>();
69: 
70:     // TODO: properly do datatype conversion

72:       var value = jsonPayload.getValue(parameter);

18:   public class SubscriptionClient {
19:     private final String name;
20:     private final String query;
21:     private final List<String> messages = new ArrayList<>();
22:     private WebSocket webSocket;
23:     private final Vertx vertx = Vertx.vertx();
24: 
25:     private final ObjectMapper objectMapper = new ObjectMapper();
26:     private CompletableFuture<Void> connectedFuture = new CompletableFuture<>();
27: 
28:     public SubscriptionClient(String name, String query) {
29:       this.name = name;
30:       this.query = query;
31:     }
32: 
33:     public CompletableFuture<Void> start() {
34:       var connect = vertx.createWebSocketClient()
35:           .connect(8888, "localhost", "/graphql");
36: 
37:       connect.onSuccess(ws -> {
38:         this.webSocket = ws;
39:         System.out.println("WebSocket opened for subscription: " + name);
40: 
41:         // Set a message handler for incoming messages
42:         ws.handler(this::handleTextMessage);
43: 
44:         // Send initial connection message
45:         sendConnectionInit()
46:           .onComplete(success -> connectedFuture.complete(null))
47:           .onFailure(error -> connectedFuture.completeExceptionally(error));
48:       }).onFailure(throwable -> {
49:         throwable.printStackTrace();
50:         System.err.println("Failed to open WebSocket for subscription: " + name);
51:         connectedFuture.completeExceptionally(throwable);
52:       });
53: 
54:       return connectedFuture;
55:     }
56: 
57:     private Future<Void> sendConnectionInit() {
58:       return sendMessage(Map.of("type", "connection_init"));
59:     }

62:       Map<String, Object> payload = Map.of(
63: //              "operationName", "breakMe",
64:           "query", query
65:     );
66:       Map<String, Object> message = Map.of(
67:           "id", System.nanoTime(),
68:           "type", "subscribe",
69:           "payload", payload
70:       );
71:       return sendMessage(message);
72:     }
73: 
74:     @SneakyThrows
75:     private Future<Void> sendMessage(Map<String, Object> message) {
76:         String json = objectMapper.writeValueAsString(message);
77:         System.out.println("Sending: "+ json);
78:         return webSocket.writeTextMessage(json);
79:     }
80:

82:     var data = buffer.toString();
83:     // Handle the incoming messages
84:     System.out.println("Data: " + data);
85:     Map<String, Object> message;

87:       message = objectMapper.readValue(data, Map.class);

60:   private Optional<String> refreshAccessToken(String refreshToken) {
61:     var payload = new JsonObject();
62:     payload.put("grant_type", "refresh_token");
63:     payload.put("refresh_token", refreshToken);
64:     payload.put("client_id", CLIENT_ID);
65: 
66:     var request = HttpRequest.newBuilder()
67:         .uri(URI.create(TOKEN_ENDPOINT))
68:         .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
69:         .header("Accept", "application/json")
70:         .POST(HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.ofString(payload.toString()))
71:         .build();
72: 
73:     try {
74:       HttpResponse<String> response = client.send(request, HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofString());
75: 
76:       var statusCode = response.statusCode();
77:       if (statusCode == 200) {
78:         var jsonResponse = new JsonObject(response.body());
79: 
80:         var newAccessToken = jsonResponse.getString("access_token");
81:         tokenManager.setAccessToken(newAccessToken);
82: 
83:         //Support rotating refresh tokens if enabled
84:         var newRefreshToken = jsonResponse.containsKey("refresh_token") ?
85:             jsonResponse.getString("refresh_token") : refreshToken;
86:         tokenManager.setRefreshToken(newRefreshToken);
87: 
88:         return Optional.of(newAccessToken);
89:       } else if (statusCode == 403 ) {
90:         log.warn(new JsonObject(response.body()).getString("error_description"));
91:       } else {
92:         log.error("Error during token refresh: {}", response.body());
93:       }
94:     } catch (IOException | InterruptedException e) {
95:       log.error("Error during token refresh", e);
96:     }
97:     return Optional.empty();
98:   }

111:       openAuthWindow();

114:       String accessToken = authToken.getString("access_token");
115:       tokenManager.setAccessToken(accessToken);
116:       String refreshToken = authToken.getString("refresh_token");
117:       tokenManager.setRefreshToken(refreshToken);
118:       return accessToken;

123:     }

127:     var payload = new JsonObject()
128:         .put("grant_type", "authorization_code")
129:         .put("client_id", CLIENT_ID)
130:         .put("code_verifier", codeVerifier)
131:         .put("code", code)
132:         .put("redirect_uri", REDIRECT_URI);
133: 
134:     var request = HttpRequest.newBuilder().uri(URI.create(TOKEN_ENDPOINT))
135:         .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
136:         .POST(HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.ofString(payload.toString())).build();
137: 
138:     client.sendAsync(request, BodyHandlers.ofString())
139:         .thenAccept(response -> tokenFuture.complete(new JsonObject(response.body())))
140:         .exceptionally(throwable -> {
141:           tokenFuture.completeExceptionally(throwable);
142:           return null;
143:         });
144:   }

147:     Map<String, String> parameters = Map.of(
148:       "response_type", "code",
149:       "client_id", CLIENT_ID,
150:       "redirect_uri", REDIRECT_URI,
151:       "scope", "offline_access",
152:       "state", state,
153:       "audience", AUDIENCE,
154:       "code_challenge", codeChallenge,
155:       "code_challenge_method", "S256");
156: 
157:     var paramString = parameters.entrySet().stream()
158:         .map(entry -> entry.getKey() + "=" + URLEncoder.encode(entry.getValue(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
159:         .collect(Collectors.joining("&"));
160: 
161:     var authUrl = AUTHORIZE_ENDPOINT + "?" + paramString;
162: 
163:     Runtime.getRuntime().exec("open " + authUrl);
164:   }

168:     var values = new byte[numBytes];
169:     random.nextBytes(values);
170:     return Base64.getUrlEncoder().withoutPadding().encodeToString(values);
171:   }

175:     MessageDigest md = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256");
176:     byte[] digest = md.digest(codeVerifier.getBytes(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII));
177:     return Base64.getUrlEncoder().withoutPadding().encodeToString(digest);

13: public class OAuthCallbackVerticle extends AbstractVerticle {
14: 
15:   private static final String MISSING_CODE_ERR =
16:           "Authentication failed: The authorization_code is not present.";
17: 
18:   private final Consumer<String> onOAuthCallback;
19: 
20:   public OAuthCallbackVerticle(Consumer<String> onOAuthCallback) {
21:     this.onOAuthCallback = onOAuthCallback;
22:   }
23: 
24:   @Override
25:   public void start(Promise<Void> startPromise) throws Exception {
26:     var router = Router.router(vertx);
27: 
28:     router.route(CALLBACK_ENDPOINT).handler(this::handleAuthCallback);
29: 
30:     vertx.createHttpServer().requestHandler(router).listen(CALLBACK_SERVER_PORT, http -> {
31:       if (http.succeeded()) {
32:         startPromise.complete();
33:       } else {
34:         startPromise.fail(http.cause());
35:       }
36:     });
37:   }
38: 
39:   private void handleAuthCallback(RoutingContext routingContext) {
40:     String code = routingContext.request().getParam("code");
41: 
42:     if (code == null) {
43:       routingContext.response().putHeader("content-type", "text/html")
44:               .end(MISSING_CODE_ERR);
45:       throw new IllegalArgumentException(MISSING_CODE_ERR);
46:     }
47: 
48:     routingContext.response().putHeader("content-type", "text/html")
49:         .end("Authentication successful. You can close this window.");
50: 
51:     onOAuthCallback.accept(code);

steps.message:
Implemented the Vert.x `4.5.14` to `5.0.0` upgrade.

Changed:
- Updated `vertx.version` in `pom.xml` and `sqrl-tools/sqrl-packager/pom.xml`.
- Replaced removed `vertx-web-openapi` with `vertx-web-openapi-router`.
- Added `vertx-launcher-legacy-cli` for the legacy `io.vertx.core.Launcher` class.
- Updated production code for Vert.x 5 API changes:
  - Future-returning APIs now use `.onComplete(...)`.
  - `PgPool` usage replaced with `PgBuilder`.
  - Health check handler package updated.
  - `VertxDataFetcher` removed and replaced with GraphQL Java `DataFetcher`s returning `Future.toCompletionStage()`.
  - JDBC pool creation updated to `JDBCConnectOptions`.
  - Micrometer registry setup updated via `BackendRegistries.setupBackend(...)`.
  - CORS setup updated for Vert.x 5.

Verification:
- `mvn -f sqrl-server/pom.xml -DskipTests compile` passes.
- Full `mvn -DskipTests compile` is blocked by an unrelated private GitHub package resolution failure: `com.datasqrl.flinkrunner:functions-common:1.0.0-SNAPSHOT` returns `401 Unauthorized`.
